_recorded: 2026-08-26, qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b via LM Studio over the tailnet, after the library-discount and KEV-floor fixes
_how: Full mode was run four times at 5 repeats and scored 0.657, 0.686, 0.771, and 0.829. The baseline records the LOWEST, not the best: anything above it is within observed variance, and a floor set at the best run would fail on ordinary sampling. Raise it only when a change is understood to have made the system better, never to turn a red run green.
_note_on_false_negatives: One of those four runs produced a single false negative. The gate fails on any false negative regardless of this baseline, and deliberately so — it is the one outcome that should always stop the line. That means the gate will fail intermittently until the underlying instability is addressed, which is an accurate report of where the system is rather than a defect in the gate.
